item.title: Xbox's First-Ever COO Is Already Leaving After A Few Months
item.description: Just a couple of months after being instated as Xbox's first-ever Chief Operating Officer, Helen Chiang has left the company. Her departure reinforces just how much of a whirlwind year 2026 has been for Xbox leadership , as the company continually attempts to reinvent itself before the start of the next generation of consoles.

item.title: Aaron Paul Originally Had A Much More Important Role In Clayface
item.description: Clayface hit theaters this weekend, but one actor's role turned out to be smaller than expected. We knew Aaron Paul would be in the DC horror flick prior to its release, but in the final film, he cameos in just one scene. In a recent interview, director James Watkins revealed that Aaron Paul had a bigger role in Clayface that was mostly cut out of the theatrical release.

item.title: 5 Years Later, Metroid Dread’s Perfect Ending Is Still One of Nintendo’s Best
item.description: Five years after its release, Metroid Dread still occupies a permanent space in my brain. Samus Aran’s nightmarish escape from a robot-infested abyss successfully revitalized the dormant Metroid series in 2021 by delivering a tightly designed Metroidvania full of challenging battles. There’s so much that’s still vivid in my memory now, but there’s one moment I have come back to time and time again: that ending.

item.title: Fallout Day 2026: Every Big Announcement from Bethesda’s Fan Event
item.description: Fallout Day, the annual celebration of all things Fallout , spanned a full five days in 2026, starting with a day dedicated to its community on Monday. Publisher Bethesda Softworks focused on giveaways, spotlights, and game announcements, making it clear that Bethesda has a lot in store for Fallout fans over the coming days, weeks, and months. The event came to an end on Friday, after a week-long series of announcements and celebrations in honor of Fallout, Bethesda's beloved post-apocalyptic franchise.

item.title: Game of Thrones’ Perfect Replacement is a 100+ Hours Fantasy Series that's Free on YouTube
item.description: If you’re looking for epic fantasy amid a whirlwind of politics and skulduggery, you’ll find little better than George R.R. Martin’s phenomenal Game of Thrones franchise. Whether it’s Game of Thrones, A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms , or House of the Dragon , the TV adaptations are a fantastic watch, with powerful, star-studded casts and insightful, in-depth worldbuilding woven expertly into the narrative.

item.title: 'Super Mario' Creator Breaks Down The Problem With AI Perfectly
item.description: Shigeru Miyamoto, one of the key figures behind monumental Nintendo franchises like The Legend of Zelda and Super Mario , recently received recognition from the government of Japan typically reserved for artists, athletes, and Nobel Prize winners. The Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology declared Miyamoto a recipient of the 2026 Order of Culture award — and the resulting press conference for the accolade is a remarkable reflection of a gaming legend.

item.title: Final Fantasy 14 Players Deliver Perfect Response to 2026’s PHP Vulnerability
item.description: A number of major websites and services went offline earlier this week thanks to a massive PHP security vulnerability . One such service was Final Fantasy 14 . That posed a major problem for plants. You see, Square Enix's MMO has a number of systems on real-world timers that continue regardless of whether a player is logged in. Those unlucky enough to be locked out of the game during the PHP issue were left fearing that their gardens would wither and die. Thankfully, the community stepped in.
